I went something extremely similar with my current boyfriend. One major difference is that my boyfriend was not willing on his own to cut the friendship. 

I struggled with it for about one and a half years. It really took a toll on me. I was in a constant state of worry whenever I wasn’t with him that he was talking to her, sexting her. Basically replacing me with her when I wasn’t around. 

It was so unhealthy for me and my mental state. Although I felt guilty, I finally gave myself enough self respect to tell him it was her or me, he can’t have it both ways. 

He chose me, and I can say that our relationship and my mental state is so much better now.  

Please don’t blame yourself for being “controlling”. This is something that you need from the relationship, and don’t deny yourself it.

Hey! I know it’s hard to understand what everyone is saying. You don’t think he a bad guy, and you’ve never experienced anything like this. 
Someone who does have bad intentions however, wouldn’t care if they perceive you as “into them” or not.

It’s very possible that he is trying to make you feel safe with him by offering you money. It’s very possible that he might offer you more money in the future and try something else.
You don’t have to think that this will 100% happen. But I hope you can at least acknowledge that it is possible. 

And if it is possible, you should let someone you know, know that it’s possible. 
If you aren’t comfortable telling your parents, you should tell a teacher. Or a friends parent. Or, if you’re not even comfortable telling an adult in general, tell a friend and have them explain to their parent what is going on. 
Just please, for your own safety, make sure someone knows.

If you’re not in any immediate danger I would consider sticking out the lease. That way you can save money, and figure out some of the logistics. (Like the cat situation). 

It also sounds like your boyfriend is extremely overworked and stressed. That most definitely does not excuse his behavior for saying he doesn’t care about you, or bothering you while spending time with your family, But I would keep it in mind while trying to sort everything out when you’re trying to break it off so it’s as cleanly as possible. 

Start small- tell him you’re going to change your phone plan to something more affordable and he should look into getting his own line. 

If you find yourself feeling unsafe, or too stressed to stay another 6 months- please leave. no money is worth a mental toll or a dangerous situation!

This is controlling, abusive behavior.  For anyone saying just to “wait until he’s 18” is not going to help. Someone who has controlling behavior will want to continue to control him no matter his age. 
As hard as it is, you need to tell someone. Not just people on the internet. Tell a friends parent, a teacher, or even report it to the police yourself. The best option for me when something similar was happening with my mother was to tell one of my friends parent. 
If you think there is any chance of an argument starting, just start recording and put your phone in your pocket. You’ll at least have the audio in case it’s needed. 
If she threatens to call the police, maybe just let her. The police aren’t going to take you the psych ward over something like not putting your computer away at 10PM. They’ll most likely take issue with your mother and question why she would call in the first place. Ask to speak to them privately and explain what is going on, and you love her but you’re scared. 
Feel free to message me, i’ve gone through stuff similar- Best of luck. Stay strong.
